text.autoconfig.stfu.title: STFU
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.maxChatHisto: The maximum number of messages to keep in chat history.
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.announceAdva: If minecraft shows advancements achieved in chat.
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.advancementT: If minecraft shows advancements achieved as a toast.
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.recipeToasts: If minecraft shows a toast when you unlock new recipes.
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.adminChat.@T: Whether you receive a message when an admin or command block runs a command.
When you receive multiple equal chat messages, compact them into one.
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.disableWidge: Disable the 2 seconds all buttons are invisible on the title screen after loading.
Disable the 2 second fade animation when the game or resources (re)load.
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.disableSplas: Get rid of the reload overlays background whenever possible.
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.disableLoadi: Hide the loading terrain and reconfiguring screen to speed up world loading.
This creates a small flicker and lag spike when loading.
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.disableWorld: Skip the warning screen for experimental settings and some datapacks.
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.fixModelGaps: Changes the item model generation code to prevent gaps.
Can cause issues on some devices.
Requires a reload to take effect.
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.nightVisionF: When night vision runs out the entire world flickers for a few seconds, this allows you to disable this.
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.animateTextu: If you disable this blocks like the nether portal will stop animating.
Combine the jump, experience and locator bars.
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.deleteToTras: Tries to move worlds to the recycle bin instead of deleting them.
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.renderThread: Thread priority for rendering. Warning: Bigger is not necessarily better!
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.serverThread: Thread priority for the integrated server. Warning: Bigger is not necessarily better!
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.ioThreadPrio: Thread priority for IO and miscellaneous async operations. Warning: Bigger is not necessarily better!
text.autoconfig.stfu.option.unfocusedVol: What to multiply the volume by when the window is not focused.
